packages.name: Now Playing
packages.description: Shows the song playing on your PC (Spotify, YouTube in a browser, any app that shows up in Windows' media controls): title, artist, time, a progress bar and an audio spectrum.
packages.author: Yuniverse
packages.changelog: The time shows hours (h:mm:ss) on tracks an hour or longer.

firmware.name: REVIVER v24
firmware.notes: PC stats is back as a built-in screen: CPU, GPU and disk, each as a temperature or a usage (pick in the Screens tab), plus the date and day. TENET Hub feeds it, so it only comes up while TENET Hub is running. Everything from v23: your own screen list, a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.

firmware.name: REVIVER v25
firmware.notes: PC stats labels follow what each number measures: CPU, GPU, RAM or DISK (pick in the PC stats tab), drawn in the keyboard's own label style. Everything from v24: PC stats as a built-in screen with temperature or usage per number, your own screen list, a screen for every screen package, changeable boot logo, the image screen, live drawing, tear-free scrolling, screen-off support.
